console.agentKeys.title: Agent keys
console.agentKeys.lede: The keys our research agents run on. No key can change the library, and none reaches an organisation's own records.
console.agentKeys.agentHint: Everything this key writes is recorded as this agent.
console.agentKeys.name: Name
console.agentKeys.nameHint: Yours to recognise it by, in the list and in the security log.
console.agentKeys.expiresHint: Optional. Leave it empty and the key works until someone revokes it.
console.agentKeys.scopesHint: Give the key the least it needs. None of these writes to the library: an agent proposes, and a library editor approves.
console.agentKeys.stepUpNote: Creating a key asks for your passkey.
console.agentKeys.stepUpTitle: Use your passkey to create this key
console.agentKeys.stepUpBody: A new key can read and write on its own from the moment it exists, so we ask for your passkey first.
console.agentKeys.secretBody: We keep only a hash of it, so this is the last time it is on screen. Put it where the agent runner keeps its secrets.
console.agentKeys.revokeBody: The agent stops working the moment you do, and a run it has open will fail. The key stays in the list and in the security log; it cannot be turned back on.
console.agentKeys.emptyBody: Create one when an agent needs to reach the API.
console.agentKeys.errorTitle: Could not load the agent keys
console.agentKeys.agentRequired: Name the agent this key runs as.
console.agentKeys.secretOnce: Shown once. We keep only a hash of it, so we cannot show it to you again.
console.agentKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? The agent stops working at once.
